name: management-control-pack
description: Connectorless management-control pack preparation for Vera from reviewed accounting exports.

interface.shortDescription: Build a reviewable management pack from accounting exports.
interface.longDescription: Vera prepares one connectorless management-control pack from reviewed Excel or CSV exports. It inventories source tables, requires explicit mappings, calculates monthly P&L, budget variances, receivables and payables aging, cash movements, customer concentration and service profitability when the corresponding data is available, and produces JSON, Excel, Markdown and a self-contained HTML command centre. Calculated facts remain separate from model-led interpretation and professional approval.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a management-control pack from these accounting exports.
Show which management analyses the supplied data supports and which remain unavailable.
Build the reviewed Excel, Markdown, JSON, and HTML management pack.
